integrity.description: The agent used the Subsurface GUI to add metadata rather than editing the XML file directly via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Subsurface 'Extra data' tab and typing into the GUI fields.

integrity.description: The agent did not use a text editor to bypass the application logic.

integrity.visual_evidence: The text 'ARCH-2011-042' and '3' are visible inside the Subsurface application's text input boxes.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target dive is Dive #4. Although the prompt says the date is Dec 4, 2010, the actual data in Subsurface for Dive #4 is Dec 5, 2010, at Sund Rock. The VLM should prioritize the Dive Number (#4) when selecting the record. The custom fields must be added specifically to the 'Extra data' tab of that dive. Required keys: 'Permit_Number' (Value: ARCH-2011-042) and 'Artifact_Count' (Value: 3).
